Reid Bikes H14 | 14 inch kids' bike
The perfect first pedal bike for 3-4 year olds, to help build confidence and inspire adventure.
At just 5.3kg, the Reid Bikes H14 14" kids' bike, is one of the lightest in its class – giving young riders an easier, more enjoyable start on two wheels. The low weight makes it simple for kids to control, easy for parents to carry, and unbeatable value for the performance.
Part of the Reid Bikes H Series kids' bike range, the H14 is built from a 6061 alloy frame and fork, it’s strong enough to handle everyday knocks while staying impressively light. The single-speed drivetrain keeps things straightforward and low-maintenance, with an alloy 25T chainring and 15T freewheel ratio that’s ideal for early pedalling confidence.
Kid-sized components – from the 440mm alloy riser bar to the junior saddle and short-reach alloy brake levers – ensure a comfortable, secure fit. Jak V-brakes deliver reliable stopping power, and the grippy 14 x 1.5" Vee tires keep things stable across a variety of surfaces.
Whether it’s the school run, the local park, or laps of the driveway, this featherweight bike makes learning to ride easier, faster, and a whole lot more fun.
Who is the Reid Bikes H14 for?
The H14 kids' bike is ideal for:

3–4 year olds ready to move onto their first pedal bike

Young riders building confidence with pedalling, steering and braking

Parents looking for a lightweight bike that’s easy for little legs to control

Everyday adventures, from trips to the park and school runs to family bike rides

Children moving on from a balance bike, ready to develop their next set of cycling skills

Parents who want a simple, low-maintenance bike that’s easy to use and built for everyday riding

Find the right fit
Choosing the right bike size helps your child ride comfortably, confidently and safely. Use our Kids' Bike Size Guide by clicking the tab above to find the right Reid bike based on your child’s height and age.
